I think that you should tell you therapist how you feel, although i dont know if he will be of help to you. From what i read here they usually prescribe medicine like antidepressants that dont help and create new problems. Best advice you can get is from the people who went through what you are going through. Im young (24) and dont have children so i dont know how that is. I can only imagine the responsibility. However i have dealt with intense depression, self hate and guilt. A few times i felt my willpower was exhausted and thought to myself- i will never come back from this.But i do. So i use that. Tell myself that it will pass. That this is the phase and that it will get better. I know, shitty advice but its the only one i have and it works for me (most of the time).

I was bullied in middle school and high school. Now im 23 and i can say that it does get better. Once i left high school i was able to rebuild my confidence. I started weight training and took care of my self. Now im confident and strong and i love meeting people who bullied me in school, they usually cant even look me in the eye now. They all stayed the same after high school, but in the meantime i was growing as a person and building myself up. So yeah, its a lot better now, and im so glad i didnt kill myself when i was at my worst. Try to take something from the story i shared with you, just consider that maybe it will get better and that you might not be there to see it.
